summary: This diff adds a single new markdown report (ai-os/TIER4_CRASH_TRIAGE_REPORT_2026-07-26.md, 240 lines, purely additive, no code or workflow files touched), documenting a triage of 12 tasks whose last checkpoint looked like a crash or no-op. I independently spot-checked the report's most load-bearing external claims rather than trusting the self-report: gh pr view confirms PR #489 is OPEN/CONFLICTING exactly as described, PR #84 and PR #79 on claude-control are MERGED at the exact timestamps cited, and the new redispatched task directory (task-20260726-171157-redispatch--land-unified-bottom-nav-stri) exists on disk alongside the original. No security, architecture, or correctness issues arise from adding a documentation file, and the diff does not touch .github/workflows/** or any tier2-triggering path (no migrations, schema, auth, permissions, payment, billing, rls, .env, or heavy deletions), so tier1 classification is correct and autonomous merge is appropriate.
